title: Partition Function
description: Essential Criteria: The partition function Z_1 must be correctly stated as Z_1 = 2 cosh(mu B / tau).

title: Probabilities
description: Essential Criteria: The probabilities P(epsilon_+) and P(epsilon_-) must be correctly derived from the partition function.

title: Total Moment
description: Important Criteria: The total magnetic moment M must be expressed correctly as M = N_s mu tanh(mu B / tau).

title: Magnetic Susceptibility
description: Important Criteria: The expression for magnetic susceptibility chi = N_s mu^2 / tau must be derived correctly under the high temperature approximation.

title: Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The entropy expression sigma_s = N_s (log 2 - mu^2 B^2 / (2 tau^2)) must be correctly shown.

title: Final Temperature
description: Important Criteria: The final temperature tau_f must be computed correctly based on the entropy changes when the magnetic field is reduced to zero.

title: High Temperature Definition
description: Optional Criteria: A clear definition of what constitutes 'high temperature' should be provided.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the expressions for M, chi, or sigma_s will lead to a deduction.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any unit inconsistencies in the final expressions will result in a deduction.
